statements.status_notes: Fixed in DHI expat 2.8.5-r1 by backporting upstream libexpat PR #1393 (commit 4d9b1c499ecb66323260a7274edcf86c5eab0517), which rejects XML_ParseBuffer() lengths that exceed the available internal buffer capacity and prevents an out-of-bounds read.

Fixed in DHI expat 2.8.5-r1 by backporting upstream libexpat PR #1392 (commit 69edbec09f2cd3e0bd6e0a093b55ea38af902d7d), which adds a runtime size check before allocation bookkeeping overhead is added and prevents integer overflow in expat_realloc().

Fixed in DHI expat 2.8.5-r1 by backporting upstream libexpat PR #1393 (commit 4d9b1c499ecb66323260a7274edcf86c5eab0517), which rejects XML_ParseBuffer() lengths that exceed the available internal buffer capacity and prevents an out-of-bounds read.

Fixed in DHI expat 2.8.5-r1 by backporting upstream libexpat PR #1392 (commit 69edbec09f2cd3e0bd6e0a093b55ea38af902d7d), which adds a runtime size check before allocation bookkeeping overhead is added and prevents integer overflow in expat_realloc().

Fixed in DHI expat 2.8.3-r1 by backporting upstream libexpat PR #1326 (merge commit 5935b102a528a85401ff982263b176c28df26618), which correctly treats getentropy() returning zero as success and preserves strong entropy for hash-flooding protection.

Fixed in DHI expat 2.8.3-r1 by backporting upstream libexpat PR #1321 (merge commit e97a6c453a4ef0595953e3f72f64ad1b74afc96a), which migrates storeAtts() isCdata lookup from a linear scan to a hash table and removes the quadratic CPU complexity.
